svg.text: the agent asks in Notion; you answer there
or with `swarm answer`; it resumes on its
branch with your answer in the prompt
same agent again, then one model tier up,
then a question for a human
the task moves straight to another
agent with capacity; the limited one
Routing: each agent scores 1–5 per task type; the best one wins, ties go to the shortest queue.
Importance picks the model tier: critical work gets the strongest model, low-stakes work the cheapest.
